corrected_code:
# Partner webhook sub-app mounted at: app.mount("/partners/integrations", partner_subapp)
partner_subapp = FastAPI()

@partner_subapp.get("/deliveries/{delivery_id}")
async def inspect_webhook_delivery(
    delivery_id: str,
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    current_partner: Partner = Depends(get_current_partner)
):
    delivery = db.query(WebhookDelivery).filter(
        WebhookDelivery.id == delivery_id,
        WebhookDelivery.partner_id == current_partner.id
    ).first()
    if not delivery:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Delivery record not found or access denied")
    return delivery
